units.source_text: 源氏公子复官以后，第一件急务是准备举办法华八讲佛事，以追荐桐壶上皇。

en.t: After Prince Genji was restored to office, his first urgent task was to prepare the Lotus Sutra eight-lecture memorial service to pray for the repose of the late Kiritsubo Emperor.

units.source_text: 他先去参谒皇太子冷泉院。

en.t: He first went to pay his respects to the Crown Prince, Reizei.

units.source_text: 皇太子年方十岁，长得异常健美，看见源氏公子回来，兴奋而又欢喜。

en.t: The Crown Prince was only ten years old, but had grown exceptionally handsome and healthy, and when he saw Prince Genji return, he was excited and delighted.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了他也感到无限怜爱。

en.t: Seeing him, Prince Genji too felt boundless tenderness and affection.

units.source_text: 皇太子才学非常优越，为人贤明正直，将来君临天下，的确可以无愧。

en.t: The Crown Prince was extraordinarily gifted in learning, wise and upright in character, and would truly have nothing to be ashamed of when he one day ruled the realm.

units.source_text: 源氏公子等到心情稍定之后，又去参见出家的藤壶皇后。

en.t: After Prince Genji waited until his feelings had settled a little, he also went to visit Empress Fujitsubo, who had taken religious vows.

units.source_text: 久别重逢，感慨之深可想而知了。

en.t: After such a long separation, the depth of emotion at their reunion can well be imagined.
